Gerunds as Subjects
You can use gerunds as the subject of a sentence.

In English, you can find that some verbs end with the suffix –ing; these are called gerunds. In this point, it is important to know that not all the verbs that have -ing take the form of the present continuous. You can also use the -ing form of a verb as the subject of a sentence.

This is one of the structures you can use when including gerunds in a sentence:

Gerund (subject) +verb in singular form + complement


Examples:

  • Deploying multiple platforms is possible when programmers use an entire executable UML.
  • Developing a software system involves many different processes.

UML Structure Diagrams
Structure diagrams are types of diagrams within the Unified Modeling Language (UML) that represent the static structure of a system and the relationship between its parts.

The elements of a structure diagram represent important aspects of a system. These diagrams are not on function of time and they do not show the dynamic behavior of the system. Through a UML structure diagram, it is possible to see the relationship of the system elements' behaviors.

The main types of structure diagram are the following:

Instructor: Pedro, can you explain UML, please?
Pedro: OK. As you know, building software systems is not an easy task. So UML helps programmers to define and build these systems. Besides, using UML allows creators to define, visualize, build, and document different parts related to software. Creating an application, for example, can be easier if you use UML because it uses Meta object facility which is very precise. Additionally, deploying multiple platforms is possible when programmers use an entire executable UML and different technologies.

Instructor: Good answer! What about the diagrams? Can you mention them?
Pedro: You can find two categories. These are structure and behavior diagrams. Through the first one, you can represent structural information. For example, in the component diagram, you can see the division of components in a software system. In the class diagram, you can see relationships and attributes among the classes. You can also recognize some other specific types of diagrams in the manual; for example, deployment, composite structure, object, and package diagrams. On the other hand, through behavior diagrams, you cannot exemplify structural information because it only displays the functionality of the software. The most common types of these diagrams are Activity, Use Case, UML State Machine, Communication, Timing, Interaction, Overview, and Sequence Diagrams.

Instructor: OK, great job! Can you tell your co-workers how to use UML?
Pedro: Well, the first thing you need to know is about the views of a system model. So, using objects, attributes, operations, and relations is necessary to emphasize the static structure of systems. In this way, you can see that the static view includes class diagrams and composite structure diagrams. In contrast, using modeling tools can help the users to simplify and represent the dynamic view. This enables collaboration among objects and modifies internal states of objects through activity, sequence, and state machine diagrams.
